name: Effect: church bell (body)
notes: Your playing shakes a church bell with its hum at C4 (262 Hz), and it rings along. An effect for in front of any amp: no amp, no cab, auto level off. The bell's partials are the ones bell founders tune to (1, 2, 2.4, 3, 4, 5, 5.33, 6, 8 x the hum), measured on tuned bells, not worked out from a shape. Simplified: every partial is shaken and heard equally. Change Lowest mode in the chain editor to tune it.
